request.name: Pip — crisp phone v2
request.edit_instructions: Crisp production-art cleanup of this exact Pip mascot. Preserve the exact pose, expression, framing, proportions, silhouette, two unequal leaves, face shape, eyes, cream face/belly, peach cheeks and hand positions. Redraw with extremely clean smooth vector-like contours, a consistent solid dark forest-green outline (#173F35), precise sharp anti-aliased edges and bold legible facial details. Flat solid sage-green fills (#ABC79F), flat warm ivory patch (#FFFEFA), flat peach cheeks (#E9B69F). Remove ALL paper grain, watercolor texture, mottling, cloudy shading, soft gradients, blur, hazy edges, shadow inside the character, and washed-out coloration. Only very small hard-edged flat cel-shading accents if necessary; mostly completely uniform solid fills. Clear separation of hands and body. Maintain friendly soft rounded shape, do not redesign the character. One complete full-body character isolated with clear margins, no added items, no typography, no background scenery, no icon tile. Transparent background in the final PNG. Highest available native image quality; sharp modern 2D mascot artwork suitable for a mobile app. Preserve the existing phone and puzzled glance exactly; give the phone a crisp rectangular forest border and a solid pale sage screen.
